risk_if_not_implemented: Without Cryptographic Protection, data in transit and at rest may be exposed through weak, misconfigured or compromised cryptographic protections. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to protect data backup and restoration hardware and software.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection (BCD-31) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Protection (BCD-24.3) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Protection (BCD-24.3) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
